# 🧰 Maintenance Checklist

## Routine
- [ ] Build from source with strict compiler flags.
- [ ] Run unit and interactive tests.
- [ ] Validate Markdown links and SVG assets.
- [ ] Review open issues and pull requests.
- [ ] Review CodeQL findings and dependency update proposals.
- [ ] Check README examples against source.
- [ ] Confirm project structure documentation is current.

## Before a release
- [ ] Update changelog and roadmap.
- [ ] Review supported platform claims.
- [ ] Run release checklist.
- [ ] Record CI evidence and known issues.

## After a behavior change
- [ ] Update architecture/function docs.
- [ ] Update tests and diagrams.
- [ ] Update project status and technical debt register.
